## Highlights
### New
- Choose borderless pages and a right-side sidebar on iPhone and iPad, with a live Settings preview and swipe-in access from the chosen edge - Look and Feel settings show one live preview of your sidebar and page beside compact, aligned controls, and every changed setting can be reset on its own - Tune tab corner shape, tab scale, pin layout, color borders, fills, hover tint, and the address field's colors, with presets for the common choices - Choose a color palette for Crest's app icon on Mac, iPhone, and iPad - Design Space crests with more heraldic artwork, shapes, patterns, independent colors, emoji, monograms, and a searchable SF Symbols picker
### Improved
- Default page zoom moved into Look and Feel and shows in the live preview - Folder color intensity and text color moved into each Space's appearance editor - Open Settings in a browser tab on Mac and iPad, with more room for controls and live sidebar customization - Keep crest previews visible while editing, with faster updates and color choices beside each part of the design - Use clearer route cards, full-width settings lists, matching icon pickers, and labeled data-retention choices
### Fixed
- Keep page addresses and sign-in cookies private when discovering site icons, and stop oversized icon downloads early
---

## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 56 user-facing changes.
### New
- Use custom search engines with website icons and optional search suggestions in each Space - See update availability and control media from a global sidebar widget deck across Spaces
### Improved
- Follow new downloads into Downloads and see live size, progress, speed, and time remaining across Mac and iPhone
### Fixed
- Show blocked pop-ups in Site Controls with a one-step allow action - Keep loading pages on-brand, reuse an open Start Page, and search tabs only in the current Space - Keep Space navigation centered and Archive controls reachable as more Spaces are added - Continue typing with the same caret or selection after returning to a webpage tab on Mac - Use compatible browser extension actions directly from webpage context menus - Keep mouse back and forward navigation within the webpage or sidebar under the pointer - Keep new-window links inside Peek and Quick Window instead of hiding them in background tabs - Start loading tabs opened from links right away, with an option to select them automatically - Refresh available updates to the newest eligible build before downloading
---
Stable releases are signed, notarized, and ready for everyday use.
